title: VPN Tunnel Health Monitoring & Alerting in Microsoft Intune — Scheduled Connectivity Health Checks, Telemetry & Alerts
author_notes: NET-NEW monitoring layer. GAP-DEDUPED (cross-reference, do NOT reproduce): 'Microsoft Tunnel Gateway — Deployment, VPN Configuration & Ongoing Operations' OWNS Microsoft Tunnel gateway-SERVER health/status in Intune — this product defers server health to it and focuses on ENDPOINT-SIDE scheduled health checks across VPN types; 'Windows Always On VPN' (device + user tunnel) products, the Cisco Secure Client / ISE VPN products, and 'Endpoint Network Connectivity Troubleshooting Toolkit' own DEPLOYMENT and reactive break/fix respectively — this is proactive ongoing MONITORING/health-checks/alerting, not deployment or one-off troubleshooting. The health-check probes use the Proactive Remediations DETECTION model (reference 'Proactive Remediations at Scale' as the engine, do NOT reproduce it). Scripts = PowerShell (device-side connectivity probes: adapter/profile/route/DNS/cert checks — READ-ONLY, no tunnel changes) + Microsoft.Graph (deploy/report the health-check package) + KQL (fleet health rollup). Everything version/feature-specific (Proactive Remediations behavior, Log Analytics/Intune data paths, Tunnel health APIs, national-cloud) flagged verify-with-Microsoft. White-label; least intrusive (checks never modify the tunnel).
